vision.name: Vegito
vision.text:
[Instant] POWER: Use when one of your effects requires you to discard 1 card from your hand during combat. Draw a card and raise your anger 1 level.
POWER: [Attack] Energy attack costing 1 stage.
Your Drills are not discarded when your MP changes levels this turn.
DAMAGE: 2 life cards.
vision.note: full-art promo (Japanese name art); edge reads HERO -> MP; Trait badges S, E, F; stats match S13 S57 but wording differs ('costing 1 stage', 'anger 1 level'); text zoomed; F badge confirmed as Fusion by the T_Fusion trait card
